markets.rules_primary: If the Federal Reserve does a Hike of 25bps on December 09, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The outcomes are mutually exclusive: at most one can resolve to Yes. For example, a 50-basis-point hike resolves “Hike   25 bps” to Yes and “Hike 25 bps” to No.

If the scheduled FOMC meeting is canceled and does not occur on its scheduled date, “Fed maintains rate” resolves to Yes and all other outcomes resolve to No.
markets.subtitle: Hike 25bps
markets.title: Will the Federal Reserve Hike rates by 25bps at their December 2026 meeting?

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. share of global GDP for 2026 is above 25.7%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the United States’ percentage share of World gross domestic product in current U.S. dollars for 2026, calculated using the World Bank’s World Development Indicators.

The Expiration Value will be calculated as: 100 × United States GDP ÷ World GDP

“United States GDP” and “World GDP” refer to the values attributed to 2026 for the World Bank indicator “GDP (current US$),” series code NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, for the economies United States and World, respectively.

Both inputs must be taken from the first World Development Indicators database release in which values attributed to 2026 are available for both the United States and World.
markets.title: Will U.S. share of global GDP for 2026 be above 25.7%?

markets.rules_primary: If OpenAI or Anthropic announces it has achieved recursive self-improvement before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The statement must describe an achieved capability in which the company's AI autonomously conducts the research and development needed to materially improve the general capabilities of its most capable or near-frontier AI systems, or produce a more capable successor, with the improved system able to drive further such improvements.

Toy, narrow, sandboxed, proof-of-concept, prompt, skill, or benchmark-only improvements do not qualify. Humans may provide high-level goals, resources, oversight, and approval, but must not supply the substantive research choices or technical solution.

The capability must be affirmatively described as currently achieved in an official company communication or by an executive or research leader speaking about the company's capabilities. Future plans, speculation, offhand remarks, interviewer characterizations, leaks, model outputs, and third-party claims do not qualify.

A public release, named model, technical demonstration, or independent verification is not required.
markets.title: Will OpenAI or Anthropic announces it has achieved recursive self-improvement before Jan 1, 2027?
